programme.desc: Marissa, 22, says her family treated her like an outcast in childhood & she later began working as an escort to make ends meet. Marissa faces family for the first time in 3 years on Dr. Phil's stage. Did they indeed reject her & is there hope for repair?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: With Nancy Grace, children's rights attorney Paul Mones & criminologist Dr. Denise Boots, Dr. Phil delves into the headlines: a starved & beaten teen escaping his torturers, an 8-year-old boy arrested for killing his father & two reporters found dead.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues with Christina, Jim & daughter Tara. She says she's worried her daughter is in a toxic situation with dad Jim & his 22-year-old new wife who is 20 weeks pregnant. Meet the new wife & find out if Dr. Phil can help this chaotic triangle.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Keith says his wife of 18 years, Sarah, is divorcing him and leaving their four children for "Kevin," a 26-year-old Kenyan pastor she met only on the internet. Dr. Phil sent a team to Kenya to investigate. You won’t want to miss what they discover!

programme.title: I Want To Be An Engineer
programme.desc: This film provides a lively introduction to the professional and personal lives of three female engineers--just a few of the growing number of women who are opting for "non-traditional" jobs.

programme.title: Beautiful Lennard Island
programme.desc: Steven Holland, age ten, is the son of the lighthouse-keeper in charge of Lennard Island, a tiny place west of Vancouver Island. He takes us on a tour and dispels any ideas we might have that living in isolation is boring.

programme.title: Gurdeep Singh Bains
programme.desc: Gurdeep is a thirteen-year-old Canadian Sikh whose family runs a dairy farm near Chilliwack, British Columbia. They have retained their language and religion. Sometimes he feels a little different from the other children because he wears a turban.

programme.title: Singlehanders
programme.desc: Alone on the open sea! Two Canadians, Bob Lush and Mike Birch, took cameras aboard their yachts during the 1980 Observer Singlehanded Transatlantic Race. The result is more than a record of this prestigious international sailing event.

programme.title: The Story Of Peter And The Potter
programme.desc: When Peter accidentally breaks a glass bowl intended as a birthday gift for his mother, Mr. and Mrs. Deichmann and their daughter Anneke, all artisans in clay, come to the rescue and make him one of their designs while Peter watches.

programme.title: Walking
programme.desc: Ryan Larkin's "Walking" captures various walking styles through line drawing and color wash techniques. It humorously portrays youth's springy steps, high-heeled minces, and elderly ambles, accompanied by unique sound.

programme.title: Atonement
programme.desc: This film shows efforts being made by wildlife specialists to preserve and nurture the creatures that do remain in our wilderness areas. Scenes rarely photographed make this a spellbinding film throughout.

programme.title: Chaque Enfant
programme.desc: This is the story of a baby who appears mysteriously on the doorstep of a busy executive, and who is subsequently bounced from household to household down the block. Nobody in the community is interested in caring for the baby without a name.

programme.title: How They Saw Us Proudly She Marches
programme.desc: A recruitment film made in 1943. Its words offer women the excitement and challenge of new kinds of work in the armed services. The visual message, however, suggests that this work is merely temporary and possibly even unnatural for women.

programme.title: Australian Ninja Warrior
programme.desc: Every day Australians take a shot at winning the first Aussie Ninja Warrior title. Contestants must complete the gruelling and high intensity obstacle course in record time to secure the spot.

programme.title: Posthuman

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: If you're in difficult economic times & looking for ways to save money, start taking notes! Dr. Phil's guests offer tips to help save on clothes, utilities & vacations. Learn how to cut your grocery bill in half & how to entertain family inexpensively.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Divorced parents Christina and Jim along with daughter Tara, 21, discuss that dad's new wife is the same age as Tara, how it's ok Tara is a webcam model to help pay bills, and that all this is making Tara a raging, angry monster with low self-esteem.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The Monster-In-Law is back! Khalood confessed to calling her son-in-law, Steve, a "loser" and "dumbass" and lacing his drink with a laxative! Does she still say Steve is incapable of supporting a family? Hear what Steve’s mom has to say about the feud!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Are you newlyweds suffering Honeymoon Hangover? The Bahamas vacation is over, the dress is put away and couples realize they now have this to face: Married Life. Dr. Phil discovers how little couples know about each other before they walk down the aisle.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Brittany claims dad Charlie is scammed by his online fiancée "Stephanie" & her roommate "Carina." Charlie has given over $25K while "Stephanie" maintains a $4.5 million inheritance is coming. The investigation starts in Los Angeles and ends in Denmark!

programme.title: How They Saw Us Proudly She Marches
programme.desc: A recruitment film made in 1943. Its words offer women the excitement and challenge of new kinds of work in the armed services. The visual message, however, suggests that this work is merely temporary and possibly even unnatural for women.

programme.title: Bobs Birthday
programme.desc: Surprise birthday parties can be risky. Especially when the guest of honour is turning 40! When Margaret plans a celebration for her husband, Bob, she underestimates the sudden impact of middle age on his mood.

programme.title: Sylvies Story
programme.desc: The film shows Sylvie in a Montréal transition house, highlighting the hurdles of violence, loneliness, and scarcity. It emphasizes sharing experiences and transition houses' support in connecting victims with legal and social aid.

programme.title: How They Saw Us Women At War
programme.desc: This 1942 British film, Women at War, contrasts sharply with similar Canadian productions. It accepts women's direct participation in the war effort as a natural outgrowth of their peacetime occupations.

programme.title: Minoru Memory Of Exile
programme.desc: The bombing of the American naval base at Pearl Harbor, by a nation he knew only by name, thrust nine-year-old Minoru Fukushima into a world of racism so malevolent he would be forced to leave Canada, the land of his birth.

programme.title: Children Of War
programme.desc: A remarkable documentary in which teenagers from war-torn countries, filmed in interaction with Canadian high-school students, speak with dignity, maturity and candor about the struggles of their people and the suffering they have endured.

programme.title: Unwanted Soldiers
programme.desc: Filmmaker Jari Osborne discovers her father's WWII involvement, revealing discrimination against Chinese-Canadians. His secret missions in Southeast Asia shed light on their quiet heroism, paying moving tribute in this multi-layered documentary.

programme.title: Canada Vignettes June In Povungnituk - Quebec Arctic
programme.desc: On a beautiful summer’s day in Nunavik, a family enjoys the pleasures of berry picking and fishing as the sound of two Elders throat-singing fills the environment. Directed by Alanis Obomsawin as part of the Canada Vignettes series.

programme.title: Perfecting The Art Of Longing
programme.desc: Using footage from security cameras, video calls and home-video archives, this experimental short film leads us on a journey through memory, family and faith, exploring the nature of connection and distance.

programme.title: Horse Drawn Magic
programme.desc: The Caravan Stage Company is the only horse-drawn open-air theatre in the world. Every summer it tours British Columbia and Alberta, bringing live entertainment to communities where television is often the main diversion.

programme.title: Sunrise Over Tiananmen Square
programme.desc: Shui-Bo Wang's animated documentary intertwines personal journey with history, exploring China's '60s-'80s upheavals. From symbol of hope to tragedy, it depicts Wang's roles from Red Guard to teacher, exploring idealism and intolerance.
